EmailTemplate.name: Day 95 - Final Contact (Last Chance)
EmailTemplate.subject: Final Contact Regarding DAF Account - Case {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Case.Successor__r.Name},
This is our final attempt to reach you regarding the Donor-Advised Fund account held by {!Case.Account.Name}.
We have attempted to contact you five times over the past three months regarding your role as successor for this account. We have not yet received a response.
ACCOUNT INFORMATION: • Account Number: {!Case.FinServ__FinancialAccount__r.FinServ__FinancialAccountNumber__c} • Approximate Balance: {!Case.FinServ__FinancialAccount__r.FinServ__Balance__c} • Case Number: {!Case.CaseNumber} • Days Since Initial Contact: 95+ days • Contact Attempts: 5
NEXT STEPS: If we do not receive contact from you within 7 business days, we will proceed with account processing as follows: • The account will be transitioned to our Operations team for processing • Assets will be distributed according to the original donor's stated charitable preferences • This will be our last communication regarding your successor designation
We encourage you to contact us at 1-800-746-2227 or reply to this email within 7 business days of receiving this email if you would like to discuss your options.
We have made every reasonable effort to reach you and remain available to assist you.
Sincerely,
{!Case.Owner.Name} Estate Administration Team DAFGiving360 Phone: 1-800-746-2227 Email: {!Case.Owner.Email} Case Number: {!Case.CaseNumber}
--- This is our final outreach. If we do not hear from you, account processing will proceed per our standard procedures.
